answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 26105 Country: India Title: Due to some unavoidable situation My sister is being seperated/ divorced. Regarding Iddat period after the divorce We want to know what is the difference between iddat after a divorce and Iddat after a husband's death. Do the restricstions of the Iddat after a husbands death apply to the iddat after a divorce. Please let us know what are the restrictions for Iddat after divorce. Can She go out for studies ?? As she is planning to continue with her studies. Urgent responce will be highly appreciated. Question: Assalamoalycoom, I need a urgent help !! Due to some unavoidable situation My sister is being seperated/ divorced. Regarding Iddat period after the divorce We want to know what is the difference between iddat after a divorce and Iddat after a husband's death. Do the restricstions of the Iddat after a husbands death apply to the iddat after a divorce. Please let us know what are the restrictions for Iddat after divorce. Can She go out for studies ?? As she is planning to continue with her studies. Urgent responce will be highly appreciated. jazakALLAH Kher Answer ID: 26105 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2445/H=910/th=1431) Some rulings are different, but the ruling regarding coming out of the home is similar i.e. it is unlawful to step out of the home to continue the study as well. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
